checks: Every extracted candidate Starter and updater file matches its exact archive; the packaged launcher is exercised unchanged.
Published 0.16.0 executes a local native SAMtools reference result and saves independent settings plus connected pipeline pins.
Packaged folder picker cancels with Escape with every baseline/reference/invalid-folder file unchanged.
Packaged folder picker rejects a real non-installation folder, explains the required files, reopens for retry and allows Escape with every baseline/reference/invalid-folder file unchanged.
Selecting the actual baseline through the published folder picker displays success, commits all 87 exact Starter core files, and preserves every recorded pack/user/result/reference file.
Repeating the update through the same real picker displays success and leaves all installation/reference files and the single transaction unchanged.
Updated private host reloads the unchanged settings and connected pipeline, finds the actual baseline result, and resolves its preserved exact reference receipt offline.
